definitions.explanation: A chemical substance used to kill bacteria and germs on surfaces, wounds, or skin. Includes both liquid antiseptics for wounds and disinfectant solutions for cleaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消毒薬|しょうどくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: To apply disinfectant to a wound.
I wiped my hands with disinfectant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急箱|きゅうきゅうばこ}→救急箱：19410_kyuukyuubako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消毒薬|しょうどくやく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{絆創膏|ばんそうこう}→絆創膏：05386_bansoukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There is disinfectant and adhesive bandages in the first aid kit.

notes:
A practical everyday word that became even more widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic. ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧ means disinfection/sterilization and {薬|やく} means medicine/chemical agent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消毒薬|しょうどくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply disinfectant
- {消毒薬|しょうどくやく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to wipe with disinfectant
- {手指|しゅし}{消毒薬|しょうどくやく}: hand sanitizer
- ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧{消毒薬|しょうどくやく}: alcohol-based disinfectant

RELATED WORDS:
- {消毒液|しょうどくえき}: disinfectant solution — emphasizes the liquid form
- ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}する→消毒する：17818_shoudokusuru⟧: to disinfect, to sterilize
- ⟦{除菌|じょきん}→除菌：07789_jokin⟧: sanitizing, germ removal — a less thorough process than ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧
- ⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧: sterilization — killing bacteria completely
